international.title: EU leaders brace for tough talks on budget and Ukraine – Europe live
international.summary: António Costa says the next long-term budget is ‘the most important’ item on the agenda Sweden’s Ulf Kristersson suggested the talks could even go beyond December and into 2027, as with the budget kicking in only in 2028, “we aren’t in that hurry.” He said the leaders should see December as “a target or a goal,” but not as “the deadline.” “I think you can’t simply say that we are will accept a budget we don’t believe in simply because we have a deadline in December 2026.” He added: “But of course we need to finalise it sooner or later so I don’t mind finding a sound and reasonable compromise in December, but we are not there yet.” Continue reading...
